title: Staff Backend Engineer (.NET) (f/m/d)
description: Staff Backend Engineer – Platform Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. If you’re driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you. About the role You’ll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform’s technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you’ll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. We don’t run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn’t the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you’ll fit right in. What you’ll be up to Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. Some of the challenges waiting for you Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. What you’ll bring to the team 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you’ve used. A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don’t have a dedicated QA function. Fluent English. Nice to have Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. What we offer Culture and growth A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. Perks and lifestyle Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. Where you’ll work from This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We’re also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Senior Product Manager - Growth
description: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide. Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 . Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s. About the role You’ll be the product owner for how companies discover Tremendous, sign up, and send their first reward. Most companies research us before they ever meet a salesperson. They find us through a search, an ad, or a reward somebody sent them. A fair number sign up on their own, either because they're too small for a sales rep or because they just prefer it. You'll own product growth overall, but self-serve clients are your primary focus and scorecard. At the top of the funnel we can't tell who's a solo marketer and who's a future enterprise buyer, so you’ll build for both. The Growth team doesn't exist yet, so you'll arrive, borrow engineers from another squad to get moving, and write the roadmap we hire against. You'll have real influence over what this team becomes and who's on it. One thing to know up front: the standard product-led growth playbook doesn't apply here. We have no free tier, no trial, and no paywall, so the usual levers don't exist. We also don't have the traffic for most A/B tests to reach significance. You'll need to look at a flow and know what's wrong with it rather than wait for a test to tell you. The product management team today is 7 PMs, led by a co-founder who serves as Head of Product. You'll also work with Marketing on campaigns and with RevOps on the handoffs between self-serve and sales. What you’ll do Own first touch to first reward sent. Signup, onboarding, and the first order are yours outright. On the site and landing pages, you own conversion and experiments; Marketing owns brand, content, and spend. Develop the growth roadmap, then help staff the squad that runs it (both through internal transfers and outside hires). Build the systems that let us test. Standing up a landing page, changing it, and killing it should take a day, without waiting on an engineering sprint. Run campaigns with Marketing. We'll pull a growth marketer into your team's cadence so a campaign ships end to end: audience, copy, landing page, emails, ads. Give promising acquisition channels product and engineering muscle: referrals, programmatic SEO, AI-search and chatbot referrals, interactive tools, reward recipients becoming senders. Turn incentives into a system. Today we hand out test funds and fee waivers case by case. You decide what we offer, to whom, and what it's worth. Prototype with AI in hours, and put it in front of real companies the same week. Work async. Most product work here happens in writing. If you're used to running product through meetings, this will feel different. Report to Prateek Mehta (Group PM). What you’ll bring 6+ years shipping web products as a growth PM, founder, or engineer, with real time on acquisition, conversion, or activation. A founder or founding-engineer past is a strong plus. Enough technical depth to ship without a full team. You can instrument a funnel, read the data, and build a landing page when that's the fastest path. Taste in conversion flows. You can look at a signup page and say what's wrong with it, without a test telling you. Judgment about when to test. You can tell whether traffic will resolve a question, and you're comfortable deciding from other evidence when it won't. Healthy skepticism of growth playbooks. You know which parts assume a free tier, and which parts transfer. Outstanding written communication. We're a documentation-first culture. What's cool about the role Blank slate. The team doesn't exist yet. You'll write the roadmap and we'll build the team around it. And since we're profitable, growth here is pure upside. Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $240,000 to $315,000. Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave. Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

title: Senior Sales Operations Manager
description: About the Role At NetBox Labs , we're building the future of network automation. Our products power network and infrastructure management for thousands of organizations, from fast-growing startups to global Fortune 500 enterprises. We’re hiring a Sr. Sales Operations Manager to help drive operational rigor, visibility, and execution across our global sales organization. This role will partner closely with Sales leadership to improve how we manage pipeline, forecasting, territories, account coverage, rep productivity, and overall sales performance. You’ll help establish scalable sales processes, translate data into actionable insights, and give sales leaders the visibility they need to identify gaps and improve execution. This role will also work closely with the Revenue Operations Managers on HubSpot administration, GTM systems architecture, and the integration stack. This is a highly analytical and hands-on role for someone who can translate sales data into actionable insights, build scalable operating processes, and help sales leaders identify and address gaps in execution. You’ll play a key role in establishing the operational foundation and cadence needed to support a growing sales organization. What you'll do Partner with Sales leadership and Revenue Operations Managers to manage and continuously improve forecasting, pipeline management, and sales operating cadences. Build and maintain reporting that provides visibility into pipeline coverage, conversion, sales productivity, attainment, deal progression, and forecast accuracy. Analyze sales performance to identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve execution. Support territory design, account segmentation, capacity planning, and account ownership processes. Partner with Sales leadership on quarterly and annual planning, including targets, coverage models, and resource allocation. Drive consistent sales processes and stage management across the organization, including opportunity hygiene and pipeline inspection. Develop dashboards, scorecards, and analyses that enable sales leaders to make faster, data-driven decisions. Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations on quota, headcount, productivity, and performance analysis. Support the operational rollout of new sales processes, programs, and initiatives. Identify opportunities to simplify seller workflows and improve rep productivity through process, automation, and technology. Partner with Enablement to translate process changes and operational insights into seller training and adoption. Maintain documentation for sales processes, rules of engagement, territory structures, and operating cadences. Serve as a trusted operational partner to Sales leadership and frontline managers. What you'll bring 4+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS company, including time at sub-$50M ARR where you built the process rather than inherited it Owned the forecast and pipeline motion end to end, including territory and quota design, coverage modeling, and rep productivity analysis Strong understanding of SaaS sales metrics, pipeline dynamics, conversion, coverage, and rep productivity. Deep hands-on HubSpot and Salesforce including the ability to pull, model, and QA your own data without waiting on analytics Built the reporting layer that sales leadership and the CFO actually run the business on, not dashboards that go unopened Partnered directly with a CRO or VP Sales as a thought partner, and with frontline managers as a coach on their own numbers Used AI and automation to remove manual work from the seller's day, with a specific example you can walk through Our stack CRM & Revenue Operations: HubSpot Sales Intelligence & Prospecting: Apollo.io Meeting Intelligence: Fathom About NetBox Labs: NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community. NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox. NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital. Our culture and values: We own and solve problems with high attention to detail. Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win. We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly. NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. description: About the Role This is a high-impact, high-ownership role at the center of how NetBox Labs drives pipeline. What you will do: Design, execute, and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns across the full funnel, from awareness to pipeline — and own the performance reporting that follows. Build and scale an account-based marketing (ABM) program targeting enterprise accounts in partnership with Sales, including tiered account plays and cross-functional alignment. Own our end-to-end email nurture strategy across audience segments — free users, trial accounts, and enterprise prospects — and continuously improve conversion through testing and segmentation. Partner with marketing colleagues to develop organic social media strategy, with a focus on LinkedIn and other channels relevant to our technical and buyer audience. Work with our agency partners to manage the website, owning updates, campaign landing pages, and conversion optimization projects — and coordinating across design, product marketing, and marketing teammates to ship on time. Partner with Product Marketing on campaign messaging and asset development to ensure programs are compelling and consistent. Track, report, and iterate. You'll be accountable for pipeline contribution, not just campaign outputs. What you will bring: 6+ years of B2B demand generation experience, ideally at a SaaS or engineer-focused company. Proven track record building integrated campaigns that drive measurable pipeline. Hands-on ABM experience — you've built the plays, not just the strategy decks. Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment. Strong command of marketing automation (HubSpot, Claude Code, or equivalent) and CRM (HubSpot). Comfortable pulling and interpreting data and making decisions from it. Experience managing website projects cross-functionally with design, product, and marketing teams. Strong written communication skills — you have experience writing sharp web copy and communicating clearly internally. Able to manage multiple programs in flight simultaneously without dropping quality. Bonus points: Experience marketing to technical audiences — network engineers, IT ops, infrastructure teams. Familiarity with open-source communities or product-led growth motions. Experience leveraging Claude or other AI tools to accelerate campaign development or, automate systems and processes About NetBox Labs: NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community. NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox. NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital. Our culture and values: We own and solve problems with high attention to detail. Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win. We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly. NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Solution Lead
description: About Summation Summation is building the AI Operator: decision-grade AI systems that help enterprise finance and operations teams turn fragmented data and manual analysis into continuously improving decisions and workflows. We combine software, analytics, and AI with deep customer collaboration to build systems that run consequential parts of the business. We are early and moving quickly. The people who join now get broad ownership, direct access to customers and company decision-makers, and the ability to turn field learning into the product and operating model of the company. The Role As a Solution Lead at Summation, you will own customer outcomes from discovery through launch, adoption, and expansion. You will develop a deep understanding of how a customer makes consequential financial and operational decisions, turn that understanding into a concrete implementation plan and new operating workflow, and lead the customer and Summation team through delivery. You will be the primary quarterback for the implementation: modeling processes and decisions, working directly with data and analytical tools, making scope and tradeoffs clear, coordinating technical contributors, resolving blockers, and staying accountable until the workflow is used and producing measurable value. You will also turn repeated field learning into product direction, reusable playbooks, and stronger platform capabilities. You will be technically and analytically hands-on, but you do not need to be the deepest engineer on every problem. Success means choosing the right problem, creating forward motion across stakeholders, and ensuring the customer adopts a system that changes how the business operates. Key Responsibilities Own enterprise implementations from discovery and planning through launch, adoption, measurable value, and ongoing improvement. Build a detailed understanding of the customer's financial or operational process, decision rights, users, data, constraints, controls, handoffs, and success measures. Translate ambiguous problems into concrete models, workflows, product requirements, implementation plans, and explicit tradeoffs. Work hands-on with SQL, spreadsheets, Python, relational databases, BI and analytical tools, financial and operational models, workflow automation, and AI-assisted prototypes when that accelerates the outcome. Lead the customer operating cadence: decisions, owners, milestones, risks, next actions, and clear definitions of done. Coordinate Forward Deployed Engineers, Product, Engineering, and data science contributors without relying on formal people-management authority. Identify adoption risks and operational-change requirements early, then work directly with customer champions and users to establish a durable new workflow. Measure whether the implementation is producing the intended business result and adjust the system or process based on evidence. Turn repeated customer needs and field lessons into product direction, implementation playbooks, reusable platform capabilities, and expansion opportunities. Build trusted relationships with customer executives, operators, finance teams, and technical stakeholders through clarity, judgment, and follow-through. Qualifications At least 3 years of experience owning implementations, analytical or operational programs, customer delivery, or similarly ambiguous cross-functional work. We care more about repeated evidence of ownership and learning velocity than an exact tenure threshold. Experience carrying an important initiative from discovery and planning through implementation, adoption, and results. Strong analytical fluency and willingness to work directly with data and models using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, BI platforms, workflow automation, and AI-assisted analysis. Ability to translate between business and technical teams and turn an ambiguous problem into a sequence of concrete decisions and deliverables. Strong customer judgment: you build trust, communicate tradeoffs clearly, handle difficult moments constructively, and create forward motion. High agency in an early-stage environment: you create structure where little exists, surface risks before they become escalations, and do the hands-on work necessary to keep delivery moving. Willingness and interest in traveling approximately 10–20% for customer meetings and team sessions in Bellevue, Washington. This travel is an expected part of the role. Strong candidates may come from implementation or professional services, solutions consulting, technical customer success, analytics or data consulting, business or strategy operations, finance systems, FP&A, enterprise planning, or other backgrounds that combine analytical depth with delivery ownership. Helpful, but not required Experience with finance, accounting, FP&A, enterprise planning, ERP, or operational analytics. Experience implementing AI-enabled applications, agents, decision systems, or workflow automation in a real business process. Experience in a startup, consultancy, or lean internal team where responsibilities were broader than the title. Experience working closely with engineers or data scientists and making good technical tradeoffs without being the primary engineer. Working familiarity with Python and relational databases. Why Join Now Own meaningful customer and business outcomes. Help customers establish new AI-enabled operating processes. Work directly with the people building the product and turn field learning into product direction. Operate with high autonomy and little organizational distance between identifying a problem and fixing it. Grow quickly through broad customer, analytical, product, and operating responsibility. Participate meaningfully in the value you help create through equity. What We Offer Competitive salary and equity options Flexible (Unlimited) Paid Time Off Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family 401(k) Plan Parental Leave A collaborative environment where your contributions directly impact our customers and product Opportunities for growth and career development

title: Implementation Specialist
description: About Double Bookkeepers today are stuck working in excel spreadsheets and homegrown project management solutions to support their clients. Double is on a mission to change that. With our all-in-one tool, bookkeepers can manage their work, communicate with clients, catch hard-to-find errors, and deliver reports to help their small business customers make smarter strategic decisions. Founded in 2021, Double has raised $12M in funding, backed by leading tech investors like Y Combinator and founders at top startups like Lattice, Front, Superhuman, Plaid, and more. Double currently helps thousands of bookkeepers and accountants manage the books for startups and small businesses across the US. We're bringing on dozens of new customers each month – you will be the first point of contact for small to mid-sized firms looking to start their journey with Double. What You'll Do Conduct onboarding calls with prospective customers, train them to use the product, and help them realize value quickly Ensure that all technical implementation and account set-up steps have been completed for each account that you onboard Coordinate with Account Executives to identify any red flags that would hinder the prospect from subscribing to Double Maintain a high renewal rate after initial three month implementation period (80-85%) Proactively reach out to accounts to ensure they're continuing to reach their goals and respond to any inbound support inquiries in a timely manner Create customer education materials: record video feature overviews, ensure product documentation is up to date, and write user guides when necessary Keep your finger on the pulse of trending feature requests and areas within the product that could be improved, then document and share customer feedback with the rest of the team to inform our product roadmap Who You Are Accounting/bookkeeping experience is required; exceptional candidates from adjacent fields who demonstrate a strong aptitude and genuine enthusiasm for the space will be considered. 2-3 years of experience in a customer-facing role at an early-stage SaaS startup Ability to articulate complex concepts in a simple, straightforward manner, both in written and verbal communication Keen attention to detail, thoughtfulness, and a customer-centric mindset Knack and passion for process improvement, documentation, and increasing operational efficiencies Familiarity with modern SaaS technologies such as Slack, Notion, Hubspot and/or Salesforce Benefits Competitive pay and equity Unlimited PTO Health, dental, and vision insurance 401k plan Double provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Telehealth Mental Health Provider (Florida)
description: Description MEDvidi is seeking experienced Telehealth Mental Health Providers to join our growing team. This is a fully remote, 1099 contractor opportunity offering flexibility, strong patient demand, and a highly supported clinical environment. At MEDvidi, we provide comprehensive mental health evaluations and treatment for adult patients experiencing conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and mild-to-moderate OCD. We’re reimagining how care is delivered. Here’s what sets us apart: Full administrative support – no need to hire or manage staff; dedicated assistants handle scheduling, patient communication, and logistics Streamlined technology – proprietary EMR with integrated PDMP and e-prescribing tools Reduced administrative burden – automated workflows and AI-supported documentation tools No software costs – our platform is fully provided at no cost to you Low no-show rates – consistent patient flow and reliable earnings Flexible scheduling – build your own schedule with the ability to increase volume over time Compensation: This is a 1099 contractor role with payment per completed appointment: Physicians (MD/DO): Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$60 per visit Follow-ups (15 min): ~$40 per visit Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs): Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$45 per visit Follow-ups (15 min): ~$30 per visit Consistent availability and schedule optimization can significantly increase total earnings. At MEDvidi, our mission is to make mental health care more accessible, affordable, and stigma-free. We leverage technology, clinical expertise, and operational support to empower providers and improve patient outcomes across the U.S. Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations via telehealth Review patient medical history, symptoms, medications, and relevant background Diagnose and treat conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and OCD Develop and implement individualized treatment plans Prescribe medications, including controlled substances, in accordance with clinical and regulatory guidelines Provide patient education on treatment plans, medication usage, and follow-up care Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation in the EMR Ensure completion of chart notes and prescriptions within required timeframes Collaborate with clinical and operations teams to support patient care and continuity Equal Opportunity Employer Statement MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Requirements Board Certified Physician (MD/DO) or Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) Active and unrestricted medical license (multi-state preferred) Active DEA registration Minimum 2 years of clinical experience in mental health treatment Experience prescribing controlled substances Strong clinical judgment and comfort managing common outpatient psychiatric conditions Ability to work a minimum of ~15 hours per week (preferred for patient continuity) What we offer None

title: Senior Strategist / Strategy Lead (contract)
description: The Role We’re hiring several freelance strategists—one Senior Strategist and two Strategy Leads —to support B2B marketing work for a fast-moving technology client across multiple lines of business and campaign workstreams. The work spans brand-level anthems, podcasts, integrated campaigns, and mid- and lower-funnel social content. You’ll work closely with strategy, design, motion, and other creative partners to turn complex inputs into compelling narratives, focused creative briefs, and channel-specific direction. We’re looking for creative strategists who can move fluidly between big-picture brand storytelling and the practical requirements of individual channels, audiences, and business objectives. You should understand how a central campaign idea translates across formats—from defining the overarching narrative to shaping social content designed to drive a specific action. The Strategy Leads will take greater ownership of strategic direction, senior client partnership, and alignment across interconnected workstreams. The Senior Strategist will lead defined workstreams and translate broader strategy into actionable creative direction with a high degree of autonomy. These engagements are expected to begin as soon as possible and continue through January 29, 2027 at 40 hours per week. What You'll Do Develop clear strategic narratives for integrated marketing campaigns and social content. Translate business objectives, audience insights, and campaign strategy into actionable direction for creative teams. Partner closely with strategy, design, motion, and production throughout concept development and execution. Help connect individual social executions to a cohesive campaign idea and broader marketing goals. Synthesize complex information into focused briefs, frameworks, presentations, and creative guidance. Present strategic thinking clearly and respond thoughtfully to feedback from clients and internal partners. Navigate multiple lines of business, evolving priorities, and fast-moving work without losing strategic clarity. Ensure alignment between the audience insight, campaign narrative, creative idea, and final execution. Shape brand-level narratives and translate them into clear campaign platforms, creative briefs, and channel-specific strategies. Develop strategic direction across formats including brand anthems, podcasts, social campaigns, and performance-oriented content. Connect broad brand storytelling to specific audience journeys, channel behaviors, and marketing objectives. Partner closely with creative teams to ensure the strategy remains clear and cohesive from initial concept through execution. What You'll Bring Significant strategy experience within an agency, brand, or similarly fast-paced creative environment. A strong background in marketing and campaign strategy, particularly across social and digital channels. Experience developing mid- and lower-funnel content that connects creative storytelling to specific audience actions or business goals. Excellent synthesis and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex inputs into clear, persuasive narratives. Strong creative instincts and experience partnering directly with design, motion, and other creative disciplines. Confidence managing multiple workstreams and collaborating with a range of internal and client stakeholders. Strong presentation, communication, and facilitation skills. The judgment to work independently, identify what matters most, and keep teams moving through ambiguity. Curiosity about emerging technology and AI, along with thoughtful judgment about how they can inform strategy and creative work. For the Strategy Lead level, we’re also looking for demonstrated experience owning strategy across complex engagements, building trust with senior client stakeholders, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and maintaining a cohesive strategic direction across interconnected workstreams. What We Offer The expected contract pay range: $61-$102 per hour. Contract compensation is determined by location, experience, and skillset. We have three regional pay ranges that are adjusted for cost of living (US1 +15%, US2 +7.5%, US3 Base), *learn more about our pay philosophy and cost of living adjustments. Benefits may be available in accordance with applicable law and company policy, including eligibility based on hours worked and duration of assignment. Compensation Additional Information

For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with companies like Google, ServiceNow, Uber, Eventbrite, and ŌURA, helping them navigate change, launch new ideas, and grow with intention. Our work spans Brand, Marketing, and Product, but what defines us is how we work. We bring strategy, design, and engineering together from the start, moving quickly from idea to execution and refining as we go. We aim to do great work and be great to work with, because both matter. We’re a collaborative, hands-on team with roots in Portland and New York and a distributed presence across the U.S. and Europe. We build teams around the needs of the work, staying nimble without sacrificing craft. We value curiosity, perspective, and continuous learning, and we’re committed to building an inclusive environment where people can do their best work. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you. The Role We're looking for a Senior Front-End Developer who enjoys building exceptional digital experiences alongside designers, strategists, and fellow engineers. This isn't a role for someone who simply executes tickets — we're looking for a collaborative problem solver who brings ideas, challenges assumptions, and helps shape the products they build. You'll work across a wide variety of client engagements, from marketing websites and ecommerce platforms to digital products and emerging experiences. Because our team is lean, you'll have the opportunity to own meaningful work, contribute to technical direction, and jump into new challenges as projects evolve. If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, thrive in a collaborative agency environment, and like building products where engineering has a seat at the table, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Do Build modern digital experiences using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and other modern front-end technologies. Partner closely with designers, strategists, and fellow developers from discovery through launch to create thoughtful digital products. Contribute technical ideas early in projects, helping evaluate approaches, tradeoffs, and implementation strategies. Own development work from implementation through delivery while maintaining high standards for performance, accessibility, and quality. Participate in code reviews, share knowledge, and help foster a collaborative engineering culture. Identify risks early, communicate proactively, and help teams solve problems before they become blockers. Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development workflows that improve how we build. What You'll Bring Experience building modern web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Experience delivering digital products, marketing websites, or ecommerce experiences. Experience working in a fast-paced agency or consulting environment. Strong understanding of front-end architecture, component-based development, and responsive design. A collaborative approach to product development—you enjoy partnering with design and strategy, not simply receiving requirements. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical teammates. Curiosity, ownership, and a proactive mindset. title: Senior Stock Administrator
description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. Discord is where hundreds of millions of people come together around games, communities, and shared interests. Behind the scenes, our Stock Administration team makes sure every equity award — from a new hire's first grant to a multi-year vesting RSU release — is handled accurately, compliantly, and with care. We're looking for an experienced Senior Stock Plan Administrator to join our team supporting the day-to-day administration of Discord's global equity programs, including equity grants, option exercises, RSU releases, and special projects. On any given day, you might be supporting the administration of equity grants, walking an employee through their vesting schedule, or partnering with our auditors to test a SOX control. You will partner with key stakeholders in our Finance, Payroll, Tax, Legal, and HR teams to answer employee inquiries, educate employees on equity programs, improve processes, implement controls, and provide reporting as needed. You will also work directly with external auditors and third-party vendors. This position will report directly to the Senior Manager, Stock Administration. What you'll be doing: Manage the daily administration of Discord's global equity plans — from participant eligibility and enrollment through award processing, exercises, settlements, tax withholding, mobility reporting, expirations, cancellations, repurchases, and terminations. Process, validate, and reconcile equity transactions across equity administration platforms, payroll, and the general ledger, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and timely resolution of discrepancies. Partner with Legal, HR, Payroll, Tax, and Finance to administer Discord's global equity programs and support ongoing processes that ensure accurate record-keeping, withholding, reporting, and reconciliation across all equity data. Maintain complete and reliable participant mobility data by tracking work locations and mobility history, and reconciling records across payroll and HRIS systems. Provide a high level of service to employees, management, and stakeholders on equity plan questions; design and deliver educational sessions and communications about Discord's equity programs. Manage the quarterly calendar of stock administration activities and prepare year-end tax information for IRC 6039 reporting. Ensure SOX compliance across all aspects of the equity plan — including documentation, testing, and audit support — and ensure all equity compensation is administered per plan terms and conditions. What you should have: 5+ years in stock plan administration, with experience at both a private and public company. Experience with global equity plans and managing an equity administration system. A passion for equity and helping employees understand their equity compensation. Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy. Bonus points: Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation. Experience with Carta. This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you're welcome to work from our beautiful SF office. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $132,000 to $148,500 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Why Discord? Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! title: Operations Risk Analyst
description: What We're Up To Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has over 1,900 markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like, really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. title: Legal (Market Contracts)
description: What we're up to Kalshi has launched the first regulated financial exchange that allows people to trade on the anticipated outcome of events. Role Roadmap We are seeking a detail-oriented and business-savvy Legal Associate (Market Contracts) to help design, draft, and safeguard the contracts that power our markets. You’ll own the legal frameworks that govern trading on Kalshi, from rulebooks and market terms to clearing agreements and regulatory filings. In this role, you’ll ensure every market contract is clear, compliant, and scalable. You’ll partner across teams to translate regulatory requirements into practical agreements that let our markets expand quickly while maintaining full regulatory confidence. Key Responsibilities Market Contract Development Draft, review, and refine contracts that govern how our markets operate, including event contract specifications, trading terms, clearing documentation, and participant agreements. Collaborate with Product and Risk to ensure market structures meet both business needs and regulatory standards. Build standardized templates and rulebooks to streamline how new markets are launched and maintained. Regulatory & Compliance Alignment Ensure all market contracts comply with CFTC regulations and other applicable laws. Work closely with compliance to incorporate rule changes, disclosure requirements, and governance standards into contracts. Stay ahead of regulatory developments affecting event contracts and derivatives markets. Cross-Functional Legal Partnering Partner with Growth and Partnerships teams on agreements with institutional traders, liquidity providers, and vendors. Translate complex regulatory and legal concepts into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal stakeholders. Act as a business-minded partner during negotiations, balancing legal precision with market growth. Process & Infrastructure Develop scalable systems for contract lifecycle management, including drafting, negotiation, and archiving. Identify opportunities for automation and streamlined review processes across market and trading agreements. Support broader legal operations, including governance, risk, and reporting. Qualifications J.D. and admission to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. 2–4+ years of legal experience, ideally: (1) at a mid- or large-sized law firm practicing commercial law, or (2) practicing law related to financial markets and/or regulatory affairs. Applicants with experience in the prediction market industry are especially encouraged to apply. Strong foundation in drafting and negotiating contracts that govern markets, trading, or financial products. Familiarity with CFTC regulations and the legal framework for event contracts, derivatives, or exchange-traded products. Detail-obsessed, pragmatic, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where law, markets, and innovation intersect. title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description: Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time. At Nextiva , we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation. Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are. If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong. While this role is open to remote candidates across Mexico, team members located within 80 kilometers of our Guadalajara office (Calle Amado Nervo 2200, Jardínes del Sol, 45050 Zapopan, Jal.) are expected to work onsite to support collaboration, speed, and execution. Nextiva is looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to lead the design and evolution of our platform engineering practice, with deep technical ownership of Kubernetes infrastructure. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role. You’ll help define how engineering teams build, deploy, and operate software by establishing platform architecture, standards, and paved roads that make infrastructure easier to consume without sacrificing reliability, security, or scalability. Nextiva operates a globally available, redundant microservices architecture and positions reliability, API accessibility, and adaptability as key elements of its technology platform. This role will help evolve the infrastructure behind that environment while supporting the growing needs of engineering and AI/ML workloads. What you’ll do Own the architecture and roadmap for our multi-cluster Kubernetes platform, including scaling, upgrades, and multi-tenancy. Establish GitOps-based deployment workflows using technologies such as Argo CD or Flux. Design and evolve an internal developer platform that provides engineering teams with self-service access to compute, environments, and observability. Architect service mesh, networking, and ingress strategies for reliable and secure communication across services. Define platform standards for GPU and ML workload scheduling and resource management on Kubernetes. Partner with AI/ML teams on infrastructure requirements for training and inference workloads. Drive capacity planning and cost optimization across Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure. Set technical direction and review architecture for platform-impacting changes across engineering. Define and own platform reliability through SLOs, incident-response leadership, and postmortems. Mentor experienced engineers and represent platform engineering in cross-organizational technical decisions. Influence teams toward common platform standards without relying on direct reporting authority. What you bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 8+ years of DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering experience. 5+ years of hands-on Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster architecture, upgrades, and multi-tenant environments. Strong hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure across AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Strong GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux. Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform or Pulumi. Deep understanding of container orchestration, networking, ingress, and service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Cilium. Experience with middleware and messaging technologies such as Nginx, Kafka, and Redis at scale. Experience with GPU scheduling, node pools, and resource quotas supporting ML/AI training or inference workloads in GKE and EKS. Experience designing internal developer platforms or paved-road tooling for engineering organizations. Strong Linux, networking, storage, and security fundamentals. Experience operating observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry at platform scale. Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction across teams. Demonstrated ability to understand, calculate, forecast, and optimize cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure costs, including evaluating the cost implications of architecture, capacity, compute, and resource-allocation decisions. Experience with capacity planning and resource optimization, balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and infrastructure cost. Additional experience that will help you succeed Kubernetes policy-as-code and security tooling such as OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or image-scanning technologies. AWS, GCP, Azure, CKA, or CKS certifications. AI literacy AI matters to this role primarily as an infrastructure and platform workload , not simply as an end-user productivity tool. Experience designing infrastructure capable of supporting ML/AI training or inference workloads. Understanding of GPU scheduling, resource allocation, node pools, quotas, reliability, and cost considerations for AI workloads. Ability to work with AI/ML engineering teams to translate workload requirements into scalable Kubernetes and cloud platform capabilities. Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies) Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors: Drives Results : Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work. Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. Total Rewards Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office. Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses. Health - Major Health insurance for you, your legal partner, and children under 25 years, including Vision and Dental coverage Insurance - Life Insurance (24 times your monthly salary) Work-Life Balance ⚖️ - Newly hired full-time employees at Nextiva receive 10 personal days before their first anniversary, 12 vacation days on their first anniversary, and 5 personal days annually thereafter in addition to vacation time Financial Security - Enjoy a 30-day Christmas bonus, 50% vacation premium, company-matched food vouchers (1 UMA/month), and a 13% matched savings fund (capped at 1.3x annual UMA) Wellness ‍ - Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives Growth - Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career! #LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform.
