Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As our <strong>VAIB Strategy Lead</strong>, you’ll set direction within your area of expertise and turn VAIB priorities into sustainable, well-governed improvements across Monzo.You’ll bring together regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience to understand where change is needed and help the business deliver it effectively. You’ll work closely with Strategy Managers and Analysts, Operations leaders, Product, Risk, Compliance, Data, Engineering and teams across Monzo. You’ll make sure our strategic priorities are understood, appropriately governed and translated into measurable improvements for customers.</p> <ul> <li>Leading the development, integration and embedment of VAIB strategies, standards and regulatory expectations across Monzo’s products, customer journeys and operational processes. Turning the strategy into clear roadmaps, outcomes and priorities, giving strategic direction to the teams responsible for delivering them.</li> <li>Assessing our products, services and customer support against relevant legal, regulatory and industry standards, identifying gaps, risks and opportunities and driving improvements. As well as horizon scanning, regulatory analysis and gap assessments, turning emerging legal, regulatory and industry developments into practical recommendations for Monzo.</li> <li>Acting as a senior subject matter expert on complex vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement issues, including situations where there isn’t an established answer, whilst building VAIB capability across Monzo by sharing your expertise, coaching colleagues and supporting the development of Strategy Managers and Analysts.</li> <li>Working closely with first and second line Risk and Compliance teams to understand regulatory expectations, strengthen governance and controls, and make sure VAIB risks are identified and managed appropriately. Whilst taking ownership of significant VAIB risks, controls, formal actions or remediation programmes where needed, making sure activity is delivered to the right standard.</li> <li>Setting clear expectations and measures for customer outcomes, using data and insight to understand whether our strategies and standards are working and where our approach needs to change.</li> <li>Work closely with Operations and Senior Operations leaders to improve customer support pathways, service standards and outcomes, constructively challenging where performance or strategic alignment falls short.</li> <li>Using complaints, customer insight, operational data and other relevant information to identify systemic barriers or poorer outcomes and turn those findings into strategic action.</li> <li>Working with Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other teams to make sure VAIB priorities are understood and embedded in the way we design, deliver and improve products and services.</li> <li>Providing strategic direction on customer communications linked to VAIB, helping make sure information is clear, accessible, accurate and consistent with our approach.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have deep expertise in vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion and bereavement, and understand how to identify and reduce barriers that can prevent people from accessing products and services.</li> <li>You have strong knowledge of the legal, regulatory and industry standards relevant to VAIB, such as FG21, Consumer Duty, the Equality Act 2010, WCAG and the European Accessibility Act, and can turn regulatory requirements, customer insight, data and operational experience into clear strategic priorities and practical recommendations.</li> <li>You have experience developing and embedding strategy at scale, including setting outcomes, roadmaps and measures of success.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with Risk and Compliance teams and have experience identifying and managing risks, controls, governance requirements or remediation activity.</li> <li>You can provide credible challenge and influence senior stakeholders, including when an issue is complex, ambiguous or there isn’t an established solution.</li> <li>You have experience using customer and operational insight to identify systemic issues and improve customer outcomes.</li> <li>You can work effectively across different teams and disciplines, bringing people together around a clear strategic direction.</li> <li>You enjoy sharing your expertise and helping others build their capability.</li> <li>You’re excited about what we’re doing at Monzo and want to help us make money work for everyone.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400-86,550 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Technical interview with a task (60 minutes)<strong><br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>The closing date for applications is 21st October 2026. However, we'll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.</p> <p><em>Shaping product and commercial strategy:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.</li> <li>You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.</li> </ul> <p><em>Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.</li> <li>Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.</li> </ul> <p><em>Changing how decisions get made:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.</li> <li>You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.</li> </ul> <p><em>Building and leading a high-performing team:</em></p> <ul> <li>You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where culture as we scale.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <p>What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe market, product line or business from an early stage.</li> <li>You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3>An overview of this role</h3> <p>As an <span class="textBold">Engineering Manager</span>, you’ll guide GitLab’s dedicated <span class="textBold">Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add-On</span> engineering team as it develops core capabilities including <span class="textBold">Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing</span>. This is a founding management role where you’ll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You’ll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU.</p> <p>You’ll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long-term delivery and quality.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Guide</span> a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Be responsible for</span> <span class="textBold">Drive</span> engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Develop</span> the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.</li> <li value="4"><span class="textBold">Run</span> regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations.</li> <li value="5"><span class="textBold">Advance</span> engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early.</li> <li value="6"><span class="textBold">Coordinate</span> quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product.</li> <li value="7"><span class="textBold">Work with</span> Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add-On scales.</li> <li value="8"><span class="textBold">Represent</span> the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll bring</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Over 3 years of experience guiding</span> backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Ability to hire and grow</span> backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Technical credibility</span> to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure.</li> <li value="4"><span class="textBold">Experience managing</span> predictable delivery across multi-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross-team dependencies.</li> <li value="5"><span class="textBold">Comfort working</span> in an asynchronous, documentation-driven organization with clear written communication.</li> <li value="6"><span class="textBold">Familiarity with</span> supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains.</li> <li value="7"><span class="textBold">Working knowledge of</span> concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore.</li> <li value="8"><span class="textBold">Ability to build credibility</span> with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork.</li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The <span class="textBold">SSCS Add-On team</span> is a product engineering team within GitLab’s <span class="textBold">Software Supply Chain Security</span> stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You’ll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability. For more on how related teams work, see <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/sec/software-supply-chain-security/pipeline-security/" target="_blank">Team Handbook Page</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Product Manager - Auth
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Product Manager for Supabase Auth https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth. You'll own the surface area that developers use to authenticate and authorize their end users and manage identity in their apps: email, phone and social login, passkeys and MFA https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/auth-mfa, enterprise SSO, the OAuth 2.1 server https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/oauth-server, auth hooks, and support for organizations and multi-tenant applications. You'll work closely with the Auth engineering team and with partners across Product Management, Security, Design and GTM. This role is ideal for someone who’s excited about building tools for millions of developers and who has a strong understanding of existing and emerging authentication practices and protocols. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll collaborate with customers of all sizes and expertise levels. Indie developers shipping a side project, startups choosing their first auth stack, SaaS teams designing multi-tenant access, and enterprises in security review. - You'll own the problem statements and solution rationale behind the Auth roadmap. This means working with Engineering and Design to shape how Supabase crafts the developer experience for the problems you’ve prioritized solving. - You'll define how Auth works for AI agents on Supabase: agents that sign users up, act on their behalf, and call APIs. - You'll use data to understand how Supabase developers are using Auth features: where they succeed, where they get stuck, and what to tackle first. - You'll keep Engineering, Design and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 5+ years of Product Management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder with equivalent depth. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc, following a design discussion, and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Have shipped standards-based auth or identity products. You've owned OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, sessions or token design, and you know from experience where each one breaks for customers. - Work comfortably with corporate buyers and with developers. You can work through a CISO's security review and an indie developer's bug report in the same week. You have intuition on which enterprise asks are real value-adding requirements and which are checkbox items. - Are comfortable with Postgres and familiar with row-level security. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - Owned auth or identity inside an integrated cloud platform. - Ran an organizations, tenancy, or SSO+SCIM launch from start to finish. - Designed auth for agents or other automated systems: OAuth for MCP clients, machine-to-machine credentials, scoped tokens. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company. Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics. Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics. Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks. Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. Bonus Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first. title: Postgres Deployment Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Postgres Deployment Engineer to join our team and elevate our PostgreSQL offerings. You'll work hand-in-hand with the PostgreSQL team and play an instrumental role in technical decision-making and refining internal methodologies. The focus of this role is around owning stability and deployment of our products. This role involves ongoing contribution and co-responsibility for builds/deployments via our public supabase/postgres GitHub repository. This repository bundles an array of features/products into docker images and AWS AMIs, giving users the ability to run Supabase on our cloud and locally. This role will function has developed as a bridge between product and infrastructure teams to improve the reliability of product deployments and upgrades. In this role, your primary responsibilities will include: - Packaging software into our supabase/postgres https://github.com/supabase/postgres repo to using either nix language with flakes, or debian packaging depending on our required target - Supporting the expansion of knowledge in Supabase toward our platform release system so that developers can self service more and more over time. - Expanding on our github actions, our team tooling, and our testing/release approaches - Timely PostgreSQL major, minor, and extension upgrades. - Engaging in proactive identification and resolution of production issues in customer deployments. - Contributing to the creation/maintaining of best practices, tools, and tests to ensure enhanced stability and decreased deployment risks over time. What we need This role demands the following pivotal qualities: 1. PostgreSQL Expert: A profound understanding of PostgreSQL and its associated tools. Familiarity with extensions, performance optimization, and best practices is essential. 2. Infrastructure: Proven expertise in infrastructure management, tooling, and optimization. 3. Self-directed & Initiative: At Supabase, we value independence and proactive problem-solving. We anticipate you to be a dynamic self-starter, thriving in asynchronous collaboration across diverse teams. Your knack for spotting areas of improvement and commitment to realizing those enhancements will be key. What you’ll do - Improve the utility and efficiency of our PostgreSQL offerings. - Work with relevant teams to understand the issues around postgres stability, and apply those insights to the build/test/deploy AMI and Docker releases. - Contribute to the enhancement of our public GitHub repositories, especially supabase/postgres https://github.com/supabase/postgres. - Develop and expand tooling and solutions within the Supabase ecosystem. - Engage with customers routinely, ensuring our solutions resonate with their needs. - Address and resolve GitHub and Support issues. Must haves - 3+ years experience with PostgreSQL and its ecosystem. - Knowledge of ansible, Nix package management system (including nix flakes), packer, docker, qemu/kvm, aws, and kubernetes deployments is essential. Need experience with linux and darwin/macos aarch64 targets, as we maintain ability to build for both architectures - Must have experience with conventional and nix-packaged builds of C/C++, Go, javascript, and Rust based projects - Exposure to public cloud platforms and deployment methodologies. - Eagerness to improve and expand our development tools/stack. - Comfortable with regular interactions with customers - Willingness to work on an “integrated” system and approach to packaging. For many reasons, we cannot apply nix packaging to every component in our stack, nor can we just adopt Nixos in production. We have successfully laid the foundation for integrating conventional and Nix-based systems, with carefully validated choices including using flakes, etc. So, you must be willing to work within and help optimize this paradigm toward our platform development. - Must be willing to take on co-responsibility for teaching our engineering team to learn, use and contribute to our Nix-based work, and help troubleshoot and solve issues around the whole platform/postgres stack. Nice to haves - Experience with PostgREST, gotrue/supabase auth, and other Supabase stack components. - Contributions to significant, open-source projects in the PostgreSQL domain. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Staff Renewals Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Staff Renewals Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll help own the operational engine that makes renewals predictable, measurable, and efficient at scale. Reporting to the Director of CX Operations, you'll be the Renewals team's go-to business partner for processes, tooling, forecasting and insights, consumption and subscription data, and the steps required to quote and close a renewal. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead through ownership and influence, connecting teams and workflows, turning ambiguous problems into clear next steps, and driving improvements that others across the revenue organization depend on.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and continuously improve the end-to-end renewal operating model; from renewal identification, assignment through risk management, quoting, through to close and post-renewal data hygiene processes.</li> <li>Develop and improve the operating cadences that guide the renewal business, with a focus on efficiency and process improvement.</li> <li>Define, maintain, and evolve retention reporting with cross-functional partners, including gross and net retention, churn and downgrade analysis, and the drivers behind each.</li> <li>Partner with Revenue Technology, Revenue Analytics, Finance, and other stakeholders to improve Salesforce and the systems and data flows supporting customer relationship management (CRM), subscription and entitlement records, quoting, orders, billing, and reporting. Translate business needs into requirements, validate solutions, and strengthen data quality and operational controls.</li> <li>Simplify and scale the renewal motion through automation, standardized workflows, alerts, playbooks, and self-service insights that reduce manual effort and improve execution consistency.</li> <li>Support renewals planning and capacity management, including segmentation implementation, coverage models, productivity assumptions, capacity modeling, supporting target setting, and scenario planning.</li> <li>Own and mature the Renewal Operations case-management program, including intake, triage, routing, service-level visibility, resolution, and root-cause analysis. Requests may include user migrations, de-duplication, Renewal Manager ownership changes, compensation exceptions, and Salesforce or data issues.</li> <li>Raise the operating standard in your domain by documenting processes, mentoring others on how the renewal motion works, and contributing to broader Revenue Operations initiatives that need the renewals perspective.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, management consulting, strategy, or a similar analytical and problem-solving role, with ownership of operational improvements and cross-functional initiatives.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with both consumption and subscription renewal motions, including renewal forecasting, retention reporting, and the contractual and process mechanics that govern how renewals close.</li> <li>Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills. title: Senior Security Risk Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>GitLab's Security Risk function is responsible for reducing risk across the security division: third-party risk (TPRM), annual security risk assessments, quarterly risk reporting, and remediation of security findings. As a Senior Security Risk Engineer, you'll take ownership of risk identification, quantification, and remediation tracking across the business, and you'll be a driving force behind automating and modernizing how the team does this work using AI and scripting. Reporting to the Security Risk Manager, you will bring expertise on risk methodology, risk-based thinking, and AI-enablement. </p> <p>In this role, you'll partner closely with Security, Legal, IT, Product, and Engineering to translate technical findings and vendor risk into business-relevant risk statements and risk treatments. You’ll help surface emerging risks, and report top risks to leadership. </p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Building and maintaining a risk register that translates technical vulnerabilities, control gaps, and third-party risk findings into quantified, business-relevant risk statements.</li> <li>Driving cross-functional remediation of security findings and risk issues to closure, tracked against SLAs.</li> <li>Driving automation and AI-enabled improvements for risk and GRC workflows so the team can spend less time on manual work and more time on high-value risk analysis and program maturity.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own risk identification, analysis, and prioritization across third-party risk (TPRM), security risk assessments, and security findings, using an established risk framework (e.g., NIST RMF, ISO 31000, or NIST 800-39). </li> <li>Translate technical vulnerabilities, control gaps, and risk findings into clear, quantified risk statements that non-security stakeholders and leadership can act on. </li> <li>Drive remediation of findings and risk exceptions to closure, partnering with Engineering, IT, Product, and Legal, and escalating stalled or high-severity items. </li> <li>Mature and maintain a risk register and quarterly reporting cadence that gives leadership clear visibility into open risk, remediation progress, and trends.</li> <li>Own and mature AI risk management, including AI impact assessments, AI risk assessments, and risk treatments, to support ISO 42001 certification.</li> <li>Design, develop, and implement key risk indicators and supporting metrics for top risks in the risk register.</li> <li>Identify manual, repetitive steps in risk and TPRM workflows and personally build the automation, scripting, or AI-enabled tooling to remove them. </li> <li>Contribute to the roadmap for the risk program, incorporating new frameworks, regulatory changes, and lessons learned from past assessments.</li> <li>Monitor the internal and external risk landscape (new frameworks, threat trends, business changes) to identify and escalate emerging risks before they become findings.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in security risk management, working with security-centric risk management or compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, NIST 800-39, ISO 31000). Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF) is a plus.</li> <li>Experience designing and executing qualitative and quantitative risk analyses that translate technical risks into measurable business impact. </li> <li>A track record of driving risk assessments, risk registers, and remediation efforts to closure across IT, Procurement, Internal Audit, Legal, Product, and Engineering, in a heavily regulated or multi-entity environment.</li> <li>Experience interpreting technical control requirements and translating them for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated bias toward automation: you've personally built scripts, workflows, or AI-enabled tooling that reduced manual risk or GRC work, not just evaluated tools conceptually. </li> <li>Comfort operating with ambiguity, managing multiple concurrent assessments, and reprioritizing under tight deadlines. </li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to translate security risks into business risks.</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud security, SaaS security models, and DevSecOps practices.</li> <li>Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC) are preferred but not required. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The <strong>Security Assurance </strong>organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk across the company. The Security Risk team sits within that group and owns third-party risk (TPRM), security risk assessments, and remediation of security findings. The Security Risk Team performs thorough, collaborative, and efficient risk assessments as well as drive risk reduction so that GitLab can achieve its goals while maintaining a high level of security. You won't just support our people systems, you'll build them: owning the code, pipelines, and integrations that keep GitLab's People automation ecosystem running reliably at scale across Workato, Google Cloud, Claude, Workday, and the tools that power our global workforce. This is a strong fit if you think like a software engineer first, write clean and maintainable code, and thrive at the intersection of people systems, AI, innovation, and automation engineering.</p> <p>In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of our People Technology team, designing, building, and maintaining the automations, agents, and integrations that connect Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, and internal tools. You'll be the go-to technical thought partner for the people group on complex engineering decisions, and your work will compound over time: fewer manual processes, stronger system reliability, and a People technology foundation that scales without friction.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Own the design, development, and maintenance of people system automations and integrations across Workato, Google Cloud Platform, Claude, Workday, Greenhouse and GitLab, writing reliable, well-tested code that runs at scale.</li> <li>Build and maintain integrations between Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, and internal tools using Workday Web Services (WWS) and Slack's API and Bot SDK, diagnosing failures proactively and driving uptime and reliability improvements across the automation stack.</li> <li>Write, version, and maintain automation code in Ruby (or comparable scripting languages) stored in GitLab, with clear documentation, code reviews, and disciplined change management practices.</li> <li>Develop and manage Slack apps and bots that deliver intuitive, automated workflows, reducing friction for People teams and employees across a globally distributed workforce.</li> <li>Move past surface-level requests to diagnose root problems, challenge assumptions, and co-design automation solutions that are durable, scalable, and built to last.</li> <li>Serve as subject matter expert on Workato automation architecture, driving standardization, reusability, and scalability across the People technology integration layer.</li> <li>Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices for People system automation, ensuring changes are tested, reviewed, and safely deployed using GitLab.</li> <li>Leverage AI tools, large language models (LLMs), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks, including Claude, to accelerate automation development and identify opportunities to eliminate manual work across the People Group.</li> <li>Provide technical guidance to teammates and stakeholders, proactively communicating context and decision-making, partnering closely with InfoSec, AI Engineering, and IT, and raising the bar for how automations, agents, and integrations are built, documented, and maintained.</li> <li>Exercise independent judgment on methods and evaluation criteria to obtain quality results, leading others by sharing solutions and problem-solving approaches.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and maintaining code in Ruby or a comparable scripting language (Python, PHP, etc.), you're comfortable in a codebase, write code others can read and maintain, and are willing to learn Ruby if you haven't already.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Workato or a comparable enterprise automation/integration platform, with a track record of building reliable, scalable automation workflows in production environments.</li> <li>Strong experience integrating with Workday using Workday Web Services (WWS), with the instinct to build integrations that are durable, observable, and handle edge cases well.</li> <li>Experience building Slack apps and automations using Slack's API and Bot SDK, with an eye for delivering workflows that actually get used.</li> <li>Proficiency with Git and GitLab for version control, code review, and CI/CD workflows, you treat automation code like production software, not scripts on someone's laptop.</li> <li>Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS; experience with Docker and Kubernetes (GKE is a bonus) for running and maintaining automation services.</li> <li>Experience connecting HR systems including Workday, Greenhouse, and internal tools, with strong instincts for where integration points break and how to keep them reliable.</li> <li>Comfort working with AI tools and MCP frameworks to accelerate development, automate repetitive work, and push the boundaries of what people technology can do.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, you can translate technical architecture into clear decisions and stakeholder updates, and you know when to surface a risk versus just fix it.</li> <li>An engineering mindset applied to people systems: you treat reliability, observability, and maintainability as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts.</li> <li>People system fluency, you understand how HR data flows, why it matters, and how to build automations that handle it with care and accuracy.</li> <li>Intellectual curiosity and a bias for action, you don't wait to be told what's brittle; you find it, frame the fix, and drive it forward.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The People Technology team is building the systems foundation that allows GitLab to scale as a global, all-remote company. We don't just keep the lights on, we push the bar on what people technology can do, constantly improving reliability, usability, and intelligence across the platforms that power our People organization. title: Customer Success Manager - 1 Year Maternity Cover, Jutland Denmark
description: This position is a one year maternity cover, with an expected start date of 1 November 2026. For the right candidate, the start date can be negotiated, and there is a possibility of extending the position beyond the initial one-year period. About Teton Our vision is to be the indispensable AI companion for care staff, transforming patient care, and ultimately operations and delivery across the entire healthcare industry. Our product is an AI-powered companion for care staff, leveraging proprietary computer vision technology to alleviate the administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden care professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care. Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI and desktop and mobile applications, Teton enhances workflow optimization, decision-making, and patient outcomes, creating a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of patient states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making. Responsibilities: You will be responsible for the customer journey from the moment the contract is signed through site planning, implementation, onboarding, and expansion. Key responsibilities include: Coordinating the successful installation of Teton’s hardware on-site, working with the technical project manager, customer stakeholders like IT, Estate planning, and care staff to create an excellent customer experience. Develop strong relationships with front-line customers through empathy and your ability to solve problems, which may mean joining a night shift and traveling around in Jutland. Partner with our product and engineering teams to successfully calibrate and troubleshoot. Provide excellent customer service, resolving issues promptly and professionally. Partner with our business development teams to run successful QBRs, identifying and capitalising on expansion opportunities. Contribute to our goal of continually enhancing our product and service based on customer feedback and needs. Qualifications: Experience as a Customer Success Manager in SaaS or other tech enabled services. You have a background in the care sector, for example in elderly care, or a social science background, for example in anthropology or sociology. You are proactive, passionate, and like to work in a dynamic team. You enjoy visiting customers regularly and are committed to understanding their needs. You are adept at onboarding and training new users. You’re excited about being part of a team that implements solutions and initiates new customer relationships. You’re great at structuring and planning. You are curious and have an outgoing profile with excellent interpersonal skills. You are based in Jutland and are comfortable travelling to customers. Some customer visits may require overnight stays. Must have a valid drivers license. Must speak Danish fluently, and be proficient in English. What is working at Teton like? We are a growing team of extremely hard working and talented people. The learning curves are steep and expanding one’s skill set is encouraged. It’s a workplace where you get your hands dirty and learn a lot. title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to support our CEO as Supabase continues to scale globally. This person will be a trusted partner to the CEO, helping manage time, communication, priorities, travel, follow-through, and key operating rhythms across a fast-moving, remote-first company. This role must be based in an APJ / APAC timezone to provide strong timezone coverage for our CEO and leadership team. You’ll work closely with founders, executives, internal stakeholders, investors, and external partners, ensuring the CEO is prepared, focused, and able to spend time on the highest-impact work. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, has strong judgment, and is excited about supporting a developer-focused company building tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Own the CEO’s calendar management, prioritization, and day-to-day operating rhythm. - Manage inbox triage and communications by monitoring emails, drafting responses, and keeping communication flowing across internal and external stakeholders. - Prepare briefings, agendas, decks, notes, and follow-up materials so the CEO is ready for every meeting. - Track follow-ups, decisions, and commitments to help projects move forward and keep stakeholders accountable. - Coordinate seamless domestic and international travel, logistics, scheduling changes, and last-minute adjustments. - Support investor meetings, board-related preparation, executive meetings, offsites, and company-wide moments. - Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion, professionalism, and integrity. - Anticipate needs, identify blockers early, and solve problems proactively before they escalate. - Partner across the company to create clarity, improve coordination, and help leadership operate effectively in a global, remote-first environment. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive in a startup or scale-up environment. - Are based in an APJ / APAC timezone and can provide strong coverage for a globally distributed leadership team. - Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences, with excellent written and verbal communication. - Have experience working in async, remote-first, or globally distributed teams. - Are tech savvy and comfortable using tools like Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, and AI-enabled workflows. - Bring strong judgment around prioritization, confidentiality, stakeholder management, and executive communication. - Are energized by organized chaos, fast-moving priorities, and solving problems before they become blockers. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, and staying several steps ahead. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

exposure to Salesforce Sales Territories, Salesforce Maps, or similar tools is a plus</li> <li>Comfortable working in spreadsheets — sorting, filtering, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and pivot tables; advanced modeling is not expected</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to working with data</li> <li>Clear and concise written communication, particularly in asynchronous settings across time zones</li> <li>Collaborative and comfortable asking questions; you will be supported, not left to figure things out alone</li> <li>Interest in learning sales operations systems and processes in a fast-paced, distributed environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting stakeholders across multiple APJ countries or working with multilingual account data</li> <li>Exposure to data enrichment or data quality tools (RingLead, ZoomInfo, D&B, Openprise, or similar)</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, or other reporting tools</li> <li>Salesforce Administrator certification or coursework in progress</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong><strong class="textBold">An overview of this role</strong></strong></p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">This is an overnight shift role with working hours of 12:00am - 7:00am EST.</span></h4> <p>As a Support Engineer on our U.S. Government Support Engineering team, you operate at the critical intersection of Support and Engineering, enabling public sector organizations and United States government agencies to run GitLab in some of the most secure and constrained environments in the world. Your work directly supports national security missions, including customers operating within FedRAMP-authorized, air-gapped, and classified or semi-classified environments where traditional troubleshooting approaches are not always possible.</p> <p>In this role, you will engage deeply with GitLab through the command line; analyzing logs, system behavior, and application performance with strong Linux fundamentals and an understanding of how GitLab’s components interact end-to-end. You may partner with Product and Engineering to reproduce and document edge-case defects using sanitized or redacted data, or contribute directly to the product by opening merge requests that resolve customer-impacting issues. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help strengthen GitLab by improving documentation, support workflows, and institutional knowledge, ensuring that lessons learned in highly regulated environments benefit the broader platform; all while working in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment built on trust, autonomy, and shared ownership.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/strace-parser"><u><span class="textUnderline">A tool to quickly analyze strace output</span></u></a></li> <li value="2"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos"><u><span class="textUnderline">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</span></u></a></li> <li value="3"><a class="textLink" href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/chatops/"><u><span class="textUnderline">A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</span></u></a></li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Collaborate closely with public sector customers, including U.S. government agencies, the Department of War, and Intelligence Community organizations, to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues in GitLab deployments operating under strict security, compliance, and operational constraints.</li> <li value="2">Perform deep, hands-on technical investigations using Linux command-line tooling and GitLab internals to analyze logs, system performance, and application behavior, often with limited telemetry or incomplete datasets. You will trace issues across infrastructure, application, and code paths to identify root causes, recommend mitigations, and drive durable fixes; frequently partnering with GitLab Product, Development, and Infrastructure teams to ensure outcomes that meet both mission and platform reliability requirements.</li> <li value="3">Create and update clear, reusable documentation and support content based on real customer interactions to improve self-service and reduce repeated issues.</li> <li value="4">Participate in regular<a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w"> <u><span class="textUnderline">pairing sessions</span></u></a> with other Support Engineers and act as a<a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart"> <u><span class="textUnderline">stable counterpart</span></u></a> to cross-functional teams to share knowledge and improve support processes.</li> <li value="5">Contribute to building and refining internal support tools and workflows, including automation and troubleshooting utilities, to make diagnosing and resolving issues more efficient.</li> <li value="6">Participate in weekday and weekend on-call rotations, providing timely emergency support for self-managed customers operating in restricted and compliance-focused environments.</li> <li value="7">Support the growth of the team by reviewing applications and assessments, and participating in interviews and hiring decision discussions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Due to government security requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to be eligible for this position</li> <li value="2">Experience managing customer-facing cases across the full support lifecycle, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge, with the ability to troubleshoot performance and configuration issues in complex environments</li> <li value="4">Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered developer tooling and gateway architectures (for example GitLab Duo, AI gateway configurations, or similar model-serving/proxy layers), including how they're deployed and troubleshot in self-managed or air-gapped environments</li> <li value="5">Ability to use scripting languages (preferably Ruby or Bash) and work within model-view-controller frameworks (preferably Ruby on Rails) to investigate and resolve issues</li> <li value="6">Practical experience with Git and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows</li> <li value="7">Skill in creating and maintaining clear, accurate support content and technical documentation</li> <li value="8">Ability to explain complex technical topics in a clear, empathetic way to customers and coworkers with varying technical backgrounds</li> <li value="9">Familiarity with DevOps practices and container-orchestration technologies such as OpenShift and Kubernetes</li> <li value="10">Understanding of common information security and compliance concepts and controls (for example DISA STIG and SELinux), and eligibility to work on United States federal customer environments as required for this role</li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></h2> <p>At GitLab Federal, LLC, the U.S. Government Support Engineering team partners with public sector organizations and United States government agencies to support GitLab in highly secure, mission-critical environments. Our work directly enables national security outcomes, supporting customers across the Intelligence Community, Department of War, and other federal, state, and local government entities operating within regulated and restricted boundaries.</p> <p>We are embedded within Support Engineering and work closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to solve complex, high-impact technical challenges. Our team frequently dives into code, logs, and architectural behavior to understand not just what is failing, but why; especially in environments with sanitized data, limited visibility, and strict compliance controls such as FedRAMP. We collaborate asynchronously across time zones and through structured pairing and discussion to share knowledge, strengthen solutions, and continuously improve how GitLab supports secure, air-gapped, and regulated deployments, while upholding GitLab's standards for rigor, transparency, and technical excellence.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Manager, Assigned Support Engineering (EMEA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div class="section page-centered"> <div class="section page-centered"> <p><strong>What this role is about</strong></p> <p>You'll manage a team of Assigned Support Engineers who provide relationship-based technical support to GitLab's biggest enterprise customers. ASEs work proactively with customers to find root causes and prevent repeat issues, which is different from working a ticket queue. They also turn their actions and activity into outcomes and deliverables that show customers the ROI they get from GitLab.</p> <p>You'll build a team that works independently, owns issues from start to finish, and knows when to ask for help. When a customer relationship is in trouble, you'll work alongside the account teams to bring it back to health. You'll also help improve the ASE program in ways that matter to customers and to the company.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hire, coach, and develop ASEs. Hold regular 1:1s, give direct feedback, deal with performance issues early, and build a team where people feel safe raising problems.</li> <li>Pay attention to engagement and retention, and coach the team on GitLab's values and operating principles.</li> <li>Train ASEs to run technical interviews so the hiring pipeline doesn't depend on you.</li> <li>Set clear goals and expectations, track progress across onboarding, relationships, escalations, and KPIs, and connect the team's work to company priorities. Help ASEs prioritize across accounts when everything feels urgent.</li> <li>Lead escalations from start to finish. Work with Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success to get the right people moving, and keep the customer informed and confident in the plan.</li> <li>Work alongside the account teams to bring at-risk customers back to health, including renewal and expansion risk driven by support concerns. Build the recovery plan, drive the technical side, and report on progress until the customer is stable.</li> <li>Help ASEs translate their actions and activity into outcomes, deliverables, and ROI, and present that to customers and executives in clear decks that cover what happened, what you're doing about it, and what comes next.</li> <li>Work with the ASE leadership team on initiatives that improve the program and customer outcomes, and see yours through to results.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Customer Success, CSMs, Product, and Engineering to push for what customers need, and contribute utilization and onboarding data to capacity and headcount planning with Finance and sales leadership.</li> <li>Document how the team works and find ways to make it more efficient through tools, process changes, and automation. Use AI well in your own work and coach ASEs to do the same.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in technical support, with at least 2 years managing customer-facing technical teams.</li> <li>Experience with high-touch or assigned support for enterprise customers. Professional services delivery counts. Experience across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com is a plus.</li> <li>A strong record of handling escalations with both internal teams and customers. You stay calm, keep people aligned, and know when to bring in leadership.</li> <li>The ability to turn a complicated or nuanced situation into a clear written story and tie activity to outcomes with numbers.</li> <li>A customer-centric approach balanced with good judgment about what the service, the team, and the company can deliver, and experience working with account teams to bring struggling customers back to health.</li> <li>A record of getting work done across teams through influence and strong working relationships. You can work with Sales, CS, and account teams to set clear expectations for the ASE service and find the right path for each customer.</li> <li>Willingness to be available outside standard hours, including weekends, for the occasional critical escalation or customer-impacting incident.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and change. You keep a team steady while priorities, processes, and the program evolve, and you explain the reasons for changes so people stay engaged.</li> <li>A strong technical foundation to guide engineers in complex, production-critical environments, including Linux system administration and web application development concepts. Familiarity with Git, DevOps practices, or GitLab is helpful.</li> <li>A history of developing engineers at different skill levels through real feedback, mentoring, and clear expectations.</li> <li>Process skills that make a team more efficient without adding bureaucracy, and comfort leading a remote, globally distributed team using metrics and customer feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The ASE team is spread across AMER, EMEA, and APAC and works mostly async, with regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, and Slack. We support GitLab's largest and most strategic customers, who run GitLab in production-critical environments. We dig into code and logs, work across departments, and focus on root cause, trends, preventing repeat issues, and providing the technical acumen that helps customers get the most value out of GitLab for their business.</p> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world.
