title: Staff Product Manager,  RevOps & Finance Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to serve as an internal PM embedded within this team. This is not a traditional external-facing product role—it is an internal platform product leadership position. You will own the roadmap for our enterprise systems, act as the strategic voice of the business within engineering, and bring senior product craft to a team of Analysts and engineers who build and operate GitLab's revenue infrastructure. </p> <p>This role is ideal for a seasoned product leader who has deep Quote-to-Cash or Finance domain knowledge, thrives at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, and is energized by mentoring high-performing teams through complex, multi-program environments.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do  </strong></h3> <p><strong>Internal Product Roadmap Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define, own, and maintain the multi-quarter internal product roadmap for QTC and Finance Systems, covering Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, NetSuite, and the CDot metering platform.</li> <li>Translate business strategy from Finance, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Sales into sequenced, prioritized system capabilities with clear outcomes and success metrics.</li> <li>Balance competing program demands—stabilization, net-new capability delivery, and technical debt reduction—with transparent trade-off frameworks.</li> <li>Drive quarterly and annual planning ceremonies, partnering with Engineering Managers and Business Systems Analysts to align capacity with roadmap commitments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements Translation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary internal product voice for all QTC and Finance Systems initiatives, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Legal.</li> <li>Lead discovery, requirements workshops, and business process design sessions to translate complex financial and commercial requirements into actionable system specifications.</li> <li>Own the decision layer between "what the business needs" and "what engineering builds," resolving ambiguity with structured frameworks and documented decisions.</li> <li>Navigate cross-functional stakeholder dynamics including SOX compliance, audit controls, and revenue recognition governance (ASC 606/IFRS 15).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Mentorship & Capability Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a product craft mentor and senior thought partner for the BSA team, actively upskilling analysts in product thinking, requirements structuring, acceptance criteria definition, and roadmap communication.</li> <li>Model and instill product management best practices—user story writing, prioritization frameworks (e.g., RICE, MoSCoW), sprint review discipline, and outcome tracking—across the team.</li> <li>Partner with leadership to evolve the operating model of the team from project-execution-focused to product-thinking-led, raising the bar for how ETA delivers business value.</li> <li>Provide structured feedback and growth coaching to BSAs on career development, helping analysts grow toward senior and lead levels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Program Strategy & Delivery Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead product strategy for major multi-quarter programs (e.g., consumption-based billing iterations, CLM/Order Forms, Zuora Product Catalog refactors, ERP optimization) from discovery through go-live.</li> <li>Define and maintain program-level dependency maps across concurrent workstreams, surfacing risks early and driving cross-team resolution.</li> <li>Own UAT strategy and acceptance criteria in collaboration with BSAs, ensuring system changes meet business requirements before production release.</li> <li>Support post-launch stabilization and continuous improvement cycles, prioritizing defect resolution and incremental enhancements based on business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Architecture Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers to evaluate build-vs-buy-vs-configure decisions for new capabilities.</li> <li>Bring informed opinions on QTC platform architecture trade-offs (e.g., billing model design, middleware integration patterns, revenue recognition rule configuration) based on deep domain knowledge.</li> <li>Stay current on platform roadmaps for Salesforce, Zuora, and NetSuite, identifying opportunities to leverage native capabilities before custom builds.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in an internal platform PM, enterprise applications PM, or systems product leadership role.</li> <li>Deep domain expertise in Quote-to-Cash systems: Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, and NetSuite ERP are the core stack—hands-on configuration or implementation experience strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to own and communicate multi-quarter internal product roadmaps to senior business and technology stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong command of revenue lifecycle processes: opportunity-to-quote, order management, billing and collections, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and financial close.</li> <li>Experience operating in a SOX-controlled environment with an understanding of audit trails, approval workflows, and change management requirements for financial systems.</li> <li>Track record of successfully running complex, multi-program delivery environments with competing priorities and shared engineering resources.</li> <li>Sufficient technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering on API design, data model decisions, and integration trade-offs—without needing to write code.</li> <li>Experience with consumption-based or usage-based billing models</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>You'll be joining the Revenue Lifecycle & Finance Systems team within GitLab's Enterprise Technology Architecture organization. Our team is responsible for the systems and processes that power GitLab's entire revenue lifecycle—from configure-price-quote through contract execution, billing, revenue recognition, and financial close. </p> <p>We are in an exciting and demanding phase: transitioning GitLab's go-to-market from a pure subscription model toward consumption-based offerings while simultaneously modernizing our core platforms. This role will be central to shaping how that evolution happens—and how the team grows in capability and product maturity alongside it.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Partner with engineering and product leadership across GitLab, developing enough context in their domains to anticipate security problems rather than react to them</li> and prototypes to unblock engineering teams and shorten the distance between a security requirement and a working implementation</li> <li>Conduct security architecture reviews for large or strategic projects, and coordinate with Application Security so that review coverage is comprehensive and correctly prioritised</li> <li>Threat model new and existing systems, and establish the patterns that let teams threat model their own work</li> <li>Work with Security Research on proactive exploration of unknown risks in GitLab's architecture</li> <li>Anticipate emerging security challenges and propose architectural responses before they reach implementation</li> <li>Mentor security engineers across the division, and represent security architecture to engineering audiences</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Depth in application security architecture, including authentication and authorization models, privilege escalation, multi-tenant isolation, and trust boundary analysis</li> <li>Experience securing distributed systems, including service-to-service authentication, secrets handling, and the failure modes of security decisions made across process boundaries</li> <li>Working knowledge of software supply chain security: build and release integrity, artifact provenance, and dependency risk</li> <li>A track record of proactive architecture work — identifying risk before it becomes an incident, and designing something that prevents a class of problem rather than an instance of one</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with engineering leadership and influence technical direction through expertise rather than gatekeeping</li> <li>Experience defining security standards or patterns that teams adopted without being compelled to</li> <li>The ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on, including reading unfamiliar code, building prototypes, and contributing changes</li> <li>Clear written communication, and the ability to make a security argument to an engineering audience that does not already agree with it</li> <li>A view on how security guidance should be authored and delivered for AI coding tools, not only for humans</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Security Architects are a part of our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/">Security Platforms and Architecture</a> team, who address complex security challenges facing GitLab and its customers to enable GitLab to be the most secure software factory platform on the market. Composed of <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/security-architecture/">Security Architecture</a>, <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/security-research/">Security Research</a>, and Application Security, we focus on systemic product security risks and work cross-functionally to mitigate them while maintaining Engineering’s development velocity.</p> <p>In FY27, we're implementing a new organizational model where each architect is dedicated to a specific functional area of GitLab's product, enabling deeper context, stronger relationships, and more proactive security guidance. As the Core DevOps architect, you'll be part of a team that includes architects focused on AI and the Sec Section, creating opportunities for collaboration on cross-cutting security challenges while maintaining specialized expertise in your domain.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. These programs include go-to-market transformation, retention and renewal motions tied to major annual recurring revenue (ARR) goals, the field-to-product feedback loop, and executive engagement with our highest-value accounts. You'll turn executive intent into workstreams, coordinate senior stakeholders across Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Marketing, Renewals, Professional Services, Data, and Enablement, and make the tactical calls that keep the portfolio honest.</p> <p>This is a founding seat reporting to the CCO while the broader Programs function is built, and the reporting line may evolve as the team scales. </ul> <p>What you'll bring</p> <ul> <li>Experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic programs at the executive level and turning ambiguous direction into delivered outcomes without a fully scoped brief.</li> <li>Experience in Customer Experience, go-to-market, or revenue-facing functions such as Customer Success, Renewals, Sales, or Revenue Operations, with fluency in retention, expansion, and adoption motions and how they contribute to ARR.</li> <li>The ability to influence senior stakeholders, including executives, and hold them accountable to commitments without formal authority.</li> <li>Judgment to make high-stakes tactical recommendations under ambiguity, including when data supports changing direction or ending a program.</li> <li>Data fluency to assess program health, diagnose where work is breaking down, and recommend a data-informed next step.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between an executive-ready narrative As GitLab transforms software development through intelligent collaboration between developers and specialized AI agents, we need security researchers who can proactively identify and validate vulnerabilities before they impact our platform or customers.</p> <p>In this role, you'll be at the forefront of security research, working with our GitLab DevSecOps platform, Duo Agent Platform, GitLab Duo Chat, and AI workflows that represent the future of human/AI collaborative development. You'll develop novel testing methodologies (including for AI agent security), conduct hands-on penetration testing, and translate emerging threats into actionable security improvements. Your research will directly influence how we build and secure the next generation of AI-powered DevSecOps tools, ensuring GitLab remains the most secure software factory platform on the market.</p> <p>This position offers the unique opportunity to help shape security and AI security practices in one of the world's largest DevSecOps platforms, working with engineering teams who are pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI-assisted software development. You'll have access to cutting-edge AI systems and the freedom to explore creative attack scenarios while contributing to the security of millions of developers worldwide.</p> <p>This role reports to the Senior Manager of Application Security </p> <h4><strong>What you'll do: </strong></h4> <ul> <li>Conduct security research in two or more specialty areas.</li> <li>Identify novel, systemic, and chained vulnerabilities in GitLab, where individual weaknesses combine for outsized impact.</li> <li>Validate security vulnerabilities through hands-on testing, developing proof-of-concept exploits that demonstrate real-world attack scenarios.</li> <li>Assess emerging industry vulnerability classes against the GitLab codebase in your areas of expertise, and drive remediation of the class rather than the instance.</li> <li>Conduct security research into GitLab's AI and agentic surfaces, and participate in defining the security requirements that engineering teams build against.</li> <li>Build the tooling and automation that scales security research, including agent-assisted vulnerability discovery across our codebase.</li> <li>Research the security posture of open source tools and dependencies integrated with GitLab, report findings to their maintainers, and track mitigation following our <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/security/disclosure/">responsible disclosure guidelines</a>.</li> <li>Solve technical problems of high scope, complexity, and ambiguity.</li> <li>Define and implement security technical and process improvements.</li> <li>Contribute to the team roadmap.</li> <li>Provide actionable and constructive feedback to the engineering teams that need to act on your findings.</li> <li>Mentor and advise other individual contributors within the team, and sometimes outside of it.</li> <li>Share knowledge and novel vulnerability types with the security community.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in security research, penetration testing, or offensive security roles</li> <li>Hands-on experience discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities.</li> <li>Be a subject matter expert (SME) of at least two technical areas impacting the security of the product.</li> <li>Proficiency in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, TypeScript, or Rust. Experience in AI frameworks is an asset.</li> <li>Ability to read and analyze code across multiple languages and codebases.</li> <li>Understanding of AI attack vectors including prompt injection, agent manipulation, and workflow exploitation</li> <li>Experience leading technical objectives in cross-functional teams</li> <li>Excellent written communication skills with an ability to articulate complex topics in a clear and concise manner.</li> <li>Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear risk assessments and remediation recommendations</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with creative thinking about attack scenarios</li> <li><strong>Nice to have: </strong>Published security research or conference presentations; Background in software engineering with distributed systems expertise; Security certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, GPEN, or similar; Experience with GitLab or similar DevSecOps platforms</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Security Researchers are a part of our<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/security/product-security/security-platforms-architecture/application-security/"> </a>Application Security team, who address complex security challenges facing GitLab and its customers to enable GitLab to be the most secure software factory platform on the market. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>At GitLab, we’re looking for a Talent Brand Manager to shape how current and prospective team members understand what it means to work here. You’ll bring GitLab’s employer value proposition to life through storytelling, recruitment marketing, candidate education, and experiences that connect our external reputation to our internal culture. You’ll partner across GitLab to turn talent brand strategy into campaigns and content throughout the candidate journey.</p> <p>This role is a strong fit for a brand, recruitment marketing, employer brand, or content professional who can move between strategy and execution. You’ll use editorial judgment, data, and cross-functional collaboration to create clear, inclusive, and authentic candidate experiences.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li value="1">Translate GitLab’s employer value proposition and company direction into clear, differentiated, and authentic candidate-facing messaging.</li> <li value="2">Deliver integrated talent brand campaigns across careers content, social media, employer review platforms, talent communities, events, and recruiter channels.</li> <li value="3">Develop and curate stories featuring team members, leaders, teams, culture, values, career growth, and the impact of working at GitLab.</li> <li value="4">Partner with Talent Acquisition to create targeted content and campaigns that support hiring priorities, pipeline generation, and conversion.</li> <li value="5">Improve candidate journey touchpoints with transparent, consistent, and relevant information throughout the hiring process.</li> <li value="6">Use content, channel, candidate feedback, and funnel metrics to improve performance and communicate impact.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate across GitLab to ensure content is accurate, inclusive, culturally relevant, and aligned with our voice.</li> <li value="8">Manage projects and external partners while improving talent brand processes, systems, reporting, and operations through iteration and thoughtful use of technology and artificial intelligence tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in talent brand, employer brand, recruitment marketing, content strategy, communications, or a related field.</li> <li value="2">Experience translating a brand or employer value proposition into content, campaigns, or audience experiences.</li> <li value="3">Strong storytelling, writing, editing, and editorial judgment across multiple channels.</li> <li value="4">Experience planning and delivering campaigns or programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines.</li> <li value="5">Comfort using performance data, audience insights, feedback, and market research to improve outcomes.</li> <li value="6">Experience influencing across functions and working with senior stakeholders, subject matter experts, creative partners, or vendors.</li> <li value="7">Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize competing work, and move from strategy to detailed execution in an asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="8">A commitment to inclusive, transparent storytelling, alignment with GitLab’s values and remote working practices, and applicable work authorization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The GitLab Talent Brand team helps candidates understand what it means to work here through marketing, storytelling, partnerships, candidate education, and recruiter enablement. We evolve GitLab’s employer narrative, strengthen regional presence, improve talent content and platforms, support targeted attraction, and use data to understand our impact on candidate engagement and hiring outcomes.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$95,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$160,800 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a strategic Territory Sales Manager  for Japan, you will own and grow your Digital Native and Retail territory with GitLab’s enterprise relationships in the Japan market. You’ll help Enterprise organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform by leading the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through rollout and long-term adoption. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager or Regional Director, you’ll use a consultative approach to understand complex customer needs, guide them through evaluation, and coordinate pre- and post-sales resources to ensure successful deployments and visible business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll work under minimal supervision on complex deals, act as the voice of the customer into GitLab, and partner closely with our strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities and develop new customers. In your first year, you’ll be expected to establish and execute clear account plans for enterprise prospects and customers in the Japan market, build strong internal and external stakeholder relationships, and consistently manage your forecast and pipeline with transparency and discipline.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Support GitLab’s strategic prospects and customers in your territory in Japan  Market, with a focus in the Digital Natives and Retail industry, owning the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts </li> <li>Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals</li> <li>Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers</li> <li>Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products</li> <li>Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management</li> <li>Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes</li> <li>Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels</li> <li>Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience managing complex sales cycles with large, strategic enterprise customers, selling into the Digital Natives and retail segment</li> <li>Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management</li> <li>Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion</li> <li>Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes</li> <li>Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis</li> <li>Effective communication and collaboration skills to share customer feedback and lessons learned with sales management, product, marketing, and technical teams</li> <li>Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Territory Sales Manager will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the Japan market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. title: Security Engineer, Detection and Response
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build. We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next. We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up. - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety. - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful. - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements. - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes. - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality. - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role. - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise. - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly. - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect. - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs. - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment. - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end. NICE TO HAVE - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry. - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale. - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections). - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows. - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling. - Kubernetes or container detection experience. - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics. - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks. - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $280,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550 and and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Credit Risk Oversight Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£79,900 - £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Credit Oversight team⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Risk Oversight team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Risk Oversight Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Risk Oversight team is crucial in providing support and challenge to our Borrowing teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) with proven experience in consumer credit risk who likes getting into the details and analysing data to deliver independent assurance - and challenge - of credit risk management across the lifecycle. </p> <p>Ideally you’ll have experience and in-depth knowledge of retail unsecured or small business credit risk strategy within financial services. You’ll have seen first-hand how a credit portfolio performs at different stages of the credit cycle, and have hands-on experience in shaping or overseeing lending strategies. You’ll have a collaborative approach, and be comfortable working across a broad range of stakeholders. You’ll also be someone who likes getting into the details, analysing data and providing constructive challenges.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Providing ongoing oversight of credit risk - this includes analysing and understanding the performance of our existing lending products, developing and enhancing monitoring metrics and providing input to relevant committees and forums  </strong></p> <ul> <li>Partnering with our first line of defence teams to support credit strategy changes - including new product launches and pilots - ensuring that we deliver magical lending products for our customers while meeting our Risk Appetite</li> <li>Delivering deep insight, feedback and challenge on our credit strategies - including data-driven analysis and actionable counter-proposals - to support management decision making and shaping better outcomes for our customers</li> <li>Leading second line assurance work on thematic reviews</li> <li>Collaborating with our model validation and model development teams to ensure understanding of the models that underpin our credit strategies</li> <li>Providing credit expertise and input into relevant strategic projects and critical Monzo-wide processes, such as stress-testing and forecasting</li> <li>Supporting us in maintaining our Credit Risk Framework and making sure it is well embedded within the business</li> <li>Taking a balanced and proportionate approach to risk management, making sure that managing risks becomes part of everyone at Monzo’s day-to-day role</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you …</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background in credit risk management within consumer or small business lending - experience in unsecured product, such as credit cards, loans or overdrafts would be particularly beneficial</li> <li>Have proven analytical skills, and can use these to interrogate data, build monitoring and look for early indicators of trends</li> <li>Have hands-on experience and/or understanding of how to use credit risk scorecards and NPV models to develop strategies for making credit decisions</li> <li>Have a solid technical toolkit; SQL or similar is a must-have, and experience using a data visualisation tool (such as Looker, PowerBI or Tableau) is a plus</li> <li>Are excited to explore how we can use AI tools to improve our credit and risk management processes</li> <li>Can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders, while providing effective and respectful challenge</li> <li>Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,900-95,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with one of our Credit Risk Oversight Managers, the hiring manager(s) for the role </li> <li>A take-home task</li> <li>Two competency, based interviews - one role specific technical interview and one behaviours and values interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TK1<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director Payment Integrity
description: Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity Reports To: Vice President, Operations This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential. Brief Description of Duties: Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise Interact directly with customers as needed Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned Minimum Skills Requirement: B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business. \n \n Please mention the word **GRACIOUSNESS** and tag RMjAuMTY5Ljc1LjMy when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuMTY5Ljc1LjMy). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L40 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework</a> you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? we do not expect prior knowledge</strong>, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> href="https://cloud.google.com/"> <strong>GCP</strong></a> for most of our data infrastructure</li> <li>React for our public web apps and internal tools</li> <li>We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>🌟 About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Model Validation team is crucial in providing independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely and ensure that the models we use deliver good outcomes for our customers. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) to join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across our suite of credit models, covering critical business disciplines such as credit strategy and impairment.</p> <p>You’ll have a particular focus on models used for customer-level decisioning and defining our credit strategies - such as underwriting scorecards, origination PD models and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models - across all our lending products.</p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is deep expertise in credit risk modelling. You’ll have hands-on experience in either model validation or model development within a financial services environment, including practical experience using Python to develop, validate or analyse machine learning and statistical models. . In-depth knowledge of credit decisioning models would be a strong plus. </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading hands-on independent validation of models used for credit decisioning within our Borrowing strategies - covering a range of machine learning, decision science and NPV models. You will be ensuring that models are fit for purpose, appropriately governed, explainable and performing as expected</li> <li>Supporting oversight and validation of broader credit risk models, including IFRS9, stress testing and economic response models</li> <li>Developing deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities</li> <li>Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required</li> <li>Performing statistical analyses to independently assess model performance, including developing challenger models where appropriate to test model assumptions and strengthen validation conclusions</li> <li>Improving our Model Risk Framework, including overseeing our policies, standards and procedures to help embed best practice across the business. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory guidelines, and adapt our processes to make sure they remain relevant as modelling techniques evolve</li> <li>Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees</li> <li>Partnering with colleagues in the first line of defence credit strategy and modelling teams - and wider risk teams across Monzo - to support the embedding of our model risk framework and establishing consistent validation standards across the organisation</li> <li>Embracing new and innovative technology, including leading the adoption of AI tools to enhance our model validation approach</li> </ul> <p><strong> 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation - in particular with exposure to machine learning or statistical models used in credit decisioning, such as decision science scorecards, origination / underwriting PD models, and NPV / unit economics modelling</li> <li>Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep understanding of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. title: Credit Risk Manager, Portfolio Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>With our Flex product we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. With our Flex product, we’re reinventing credit cards to give customers more visibility and control over their spending. Flex portfolio management is currently in its infancy—meaning this role is a true "zero-to-one" blank canvas. Flex behaves differently from a standard credit card, so we are looking for a highly strategic Credit Risk Manager who can challenge legacy banking assumptions, think from first principles, and put the customer at the heart of our lifecycle strategies.</p> <p>You will lead an initial team of 3 credit analysts (with scope to grow the team over time) to unlock massive P&L and customer engagement potential on a rapidly growing portfolio. While the immediate focus is scaling safely in the UK, you will help lay the groundwork for a global footprint as Monzo expands into Europe.</p> <p>Our credit teams are part of our Data Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own Portfolio Monitoring & Forecasting:</strong> Build and oversee robust performance frameworks to monitor and forecast both risk and revenue metrics, ensuring our rapidly growing portfolio scales sustainably.</li> <li><strong>Drive Contractual Pricing Strategies:</strong> Architect and optimise an ongoing risk-based pricing program that balances commercial viability and fair customer outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Fuel Engagement & Retention Loops:</strong> Design and deploy sophisticated credit strategies for lifecycle events, including product upgrades, engagement incentives, and balance transfer propositions that deepen customer loyalty.</li> <li><strong>Execute Data-Driven Loss Mitigation:</strong> Develop proactive risk management frameworks—such as credit limit decrease strategies—to safely mitigate losses and support financially vulnerable customers.</li> <li><strong>Lead and Nurture Talent:</strong> Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of 3 credit analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and strong commercial focus.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Squad Collaboration:</strong> Act as the embedded credit risk expert within a multi-disciplinary squad, working side-by-side with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Customer Research, and Risk & Control.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional Leadership:</strong> Build deep collaborative ties with wider credit functions and manage relationships with 2nd Line Credit Risk, Legal, and Compliance, while translating complex data into clear narratives for executive-level stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work:</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our data teams are based all over the UK — from Brighton to the Western Isles.</p> <p>We love meeting in person, but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you’re nearby. You’ll do your best work where you feel most comfortable.</p> <p>We value flexibility, connection, and wellbeing. You’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life, whether that’s school drop-offs, avoiding rush hour, or making time for what matters most.</p> <p>Work the way that works for you at Monzo! 💼</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li><strong>You are a commercial, strategic credit leader</strong> with a deep understanding of unsecured lending portfolios—ideally with exposure to credit card lifecycle management.</li> <li><strong>You thrive in ambiguous, "zero-to-one" environments.</strong> You love building strategies from scratch, questioning traditional banking norms, and working at pace.</li> <li><strong>You have portfolio management experience, </strong>including risk-based pricing, retention, product upgrades, and loss mitigation strategies.</li> <li><strong>You are a champion for both Credit and Conduct Risk.</strong> You naturally balance sharp credit instincts with a passion for protecting customers and delivering delightful experiences.</li> <li><strong>You are an exceptional stakeholder manager and storyteller.</strong> You can smoothly collaborate with engineering squads, align with legal and compliance partners, and influence up to executive leadership.</li> <li><strong>You love developing people.</strong> You have a proven track record of leading analytical talent and are energized by the prospect of managing and growing a high-impact team.</li> <li><strong>You have strong technical and data capabilities.</strong> You are comfortable digging into data yourself and driving a data-first culture (SQL is a must-have; Python and Looker experience is a plus).</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call </li> <li>Initial call with the hiring manager </li> <li>Final loop of interviews meeting the team</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-COD #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. Your work will focus on improving our efforts in financial crime detection, prevention and mitigation, ensuring we stay ahead of emerging threats and regulatory requirements.</p> <p>You’ll help your team grow, hiring new team members, supporting their personal development. You will manage a team with Data Scientists and Data Analysts, working together with Analytics Engineers to drive product innovation and you’ll get to see the impact of all your work in the product changes we make.</p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives data folk the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day </strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a key leader in building a discipline of exceptional data scientists and analysts working on making Monzo world class at detecting and fighting financial crime activity</li> <li>Help hire, develop and retain talented Data people</li> <li>Generate insights that can change the direction of our financial crime strategy</li> <li>Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development and build a strategic understanding of the business while structuring complex projects to bring them to life</li> <li>Liaise with risk, product and engineering managers to keep making sure we collect the right data to produce relevant business insights</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You <strong>must</strong> have at least 4 years of experience as a Data Science Manager- at least 2 of them managing a data team larger than 4 people</li> <li>You are a strong strategic data leader and love to drive decisions</li> <li>Strong experience with working with executive or C-level peers, managing stakeholders across levels of seniorities and disciplines</li> <li>You know what it takes to manage top tier Data talent</li> <li>You’re excited by the opportunity to work autonomously to impact the future of a fast growing, ever evolving business</li> <li>You're familiar with using a variety of Data Science tools (from business intelligence, experimentation and causal inference through to machine learning), and coding languages (Python and SQL). You know when to pick the right tool, and can help others do the same</li> <li>Experience in financial crime, fraud detection, or similar areas (Trust & Safety, Integrity, Security) is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <ul> <li>30 minute recruiter call </li> <li>45 minute call with hiring manager </li> <li>3 x 1-hour video calls with various team members</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p>We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself. As a senior leader within the Design organisation, you’ll raise the quality bar and expand design’s impact, influence, and effectiveness across Monzo.</p> <p> </p> <h2>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</h2> <ul> <li>Setting the strategic direction and design vision for your area, inspiring teams to think bigger and bolder, whilst aligning with Monzo goals and mission.</li> <li>Partnering with the leadership team for your area to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and turn strategy into impactful execution.</li> <li>Building and nurturing a high-performing design team - investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.</li> <li>Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.</li> <li>Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.</li> <li>Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...</h2> <ul> <li>You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.</li> <li>You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.</li> <li>You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.</li> <li>You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.</li> <li>You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.</li> <li>You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.</li> <li>You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>🙌 What’s in it for you</h2> <ul> <li>💰 £140,000 - Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-TR1</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. across Europe.</p> <p>This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll work on</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.</li> <li>Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.</li> <li>Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.</li> <li>Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.</li> <li>Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.</li> <li>Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.</li> <li>Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.</li> <li>Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.</li> <li>Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You should apply if</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.</li> <li>You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.</li> <li>You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.</li> <li>You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.</li> <li>You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.</li> <li>You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.</li> <li>You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The interview process</strong></h3> <p>After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages: </p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial Call (1 hour)</strong> You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage</strong> - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.</li> </ol> <p>At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.<br><br></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby.
